summary: Addex Therapeutics, a Swiss biopharma, disclosed via Form 6-K that its spin-out Neurosterix is on track to complete a Phase 1 study of NTX-253 for schizophrenia in Q2 2026. The filing incorporates a press release and references the spin-off structure. No financial terms (price per share, premium) or board recommendations are given; the update focuses on clinical progress. The spin-out was previously announced and is not a new event. The filing is a routine progress report on an existing special situation (spin-off) rather than a new triggering event. Watch for completion of Phase 1 results or any subsequent transaction.
